let mode='quick';const presets={idle:{cycle:2400,sway:.5,breath:.4,size:scene.archer.h},quick:{duration:950,draw:55,flight:180,recoil:2.1,trail:55,impact:55,snap:70,charge:65,burst:60,size:scene.archer.h},pierce:{duration:1150,draw:55,flight:160,recoil:2.1,trail:80,impact:80,snap:70,charge:85,burst:75,fracture:80,size:scene.archer.h},power:{duration:2200,draw:60,flight:220,recoil:4,trail:95,impact:95,snap:85,charge:100,burst:95,size:scene.archer.h}};
const effect=(g,v,f)=>mode==='pierce'?v:mode==='power'?f:g;
function applyMode(){for(const [id,name,min,max,val,unit] of defs){const visible=id in presets[mode];$(id).parentElement.style.display=visible?'block':'none';if(visible)$(id).value=presets[mode][id];$(id+'out').textContent=$(id).value+unit;}phase=0;setPlaying(mode==='idle');render()}
$('mode').onchange=()=>{for(const id of Object.keys(presets[mode]))presets[mode][id]=v(id);mode=$('mode').value;applyMode()};
function render(){const glow=effect(glowG,glowV,glowF),wind=effect(windG,windV,windF),flash=effect(flashG,flashV,flashF);if(!ready)return;ctx.setTransform(scene.pixelRatio,0,0,scene.pixelRatio,0,0);ctx.clearRect(0,0,scene.width,scene.height);const idle=mode==='idle',t=idle?0:phase*v('duration'),release=v('duration')*(mode==='power'?.66:mode==='pierce'?.48:.42),land=release+v('flight'),hit=Math.max(0,1-(t-land)/180)*(t>=land?1:0);const Solve the elbow on a circular arc.
const sx=405,sy=218,ex=420,ey=263,wx=313,wy=239;
const L1=Math.hypot(ex-sx,ey-sy),L2=Math.hypot(wx-ex,wy-ey);
const hx=hand,hy=239;const dx=hx-sx,dy=hy-sy,D=Math.hypot(dx,dy),dist=Math.min(L1+L2-.2,Math.max(Math.abs(L1-L2)+.2,D));

segment('upper',sx,sy,sx,sy,Math.atan2(jy-sy,jx-sx)-Math.atan2(ey-sy,ex-sx));

function tick(now){if(playing&&last){phase+=Math.min(now-last,80)/v(mode==='idle'?'cycle':'duration');if(mode==='idle')phase%=1;else if(phase>=1){phase=1;setPlaying(false)}}last=now;render();requestAnimationFrame(tick)}
